description.value: The Hangar is a bouldering-only climbing gym on the Sunshine Coast in Sechelt, founded in 2017 as a community hub for active locals and visitors. It features thick foam flooring, weekly route setting, and a self-serve snack and drinks bar, positioning itself as much a social hangout as a climbing facility. Touring cyclists on the popular Sunshine Coast route may enjoy it as a rest-day activity or rainy-day diversion.
